dialogue.content: （おはようございます。本日はどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Good morning. I look forward to our session today.)

dialogue.content: 「おはようございます本日は宜しくお願い致します」
dialogue.English: Good morning. I look forward to our session today as well.

dialogue.content: 「リクエスト希望ありましたらお願い致します」
dialogue.English: If you have any requests or preferences, please let me know.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます、ご自身の今までに解決された問題等で、もし、ありましたらよろしくお願いします！
dialogue.English: Thank you. If there are any past issues you've resolved that you'd like to use for our session, please feel free.

dialogue.content: （それでは始めさせていただきますね）
dialogue.English: (Alright, let's begin.)

dialogue.content: 承知致しました宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Understood. I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: おはようございます。相談員です。性別ご年齢をお伺いしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good morning. I'm a counselor. May I ask your gender and age?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: １５歳男です
dialogue.English: I’m a 15-year-old male.

dialogue.content: （ごめんなさい、電波が良くないみたいで、メッセージが遅れるかもしれません）
dialogue.English: (I'm sorry, my connection seems to be unstable, so my messages might be delayed.)

dialogue.content: 「私も外で全然大丈夫です」
dialogue.English: I'm outside as well, so that's perfectly fine.

dialogue.content: 15歳男性ですね、今日はどのようなことでお越しいただいたのですか？また、なんとお呼びしたらよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you’re a 15-year-old male. What brings you in today? And how would you like me to address you?

dialogue.content: たつやでお願いします
dialogue.English: Please call me Tatsuya.

dialogue.content: 学校のことで
dialogue.English: It's about school.

dialogue.content: たつやさんですね、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Tatsuya, got it. Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、学校での事なのですね
dialogue.English: Ah, it's about something at school, then.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ、どうされましたか？もし話せそうでしたら、話せるところからお話くださいね
dialogue.English: I see, I see. What has been going on? If you feel up to it, please feel free to start wherever you're comfortable.

dialogue.content: 実は学校にいってなくてその事で相談にきました
dialogue.English: Actually, I haven't been going to school, and that's what I wanted to talk about.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、学校にはどのくらい行ってないのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How long has it been since you last went to school?

dialogue.content: もうずっと行けてないです
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to go for a long time now.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、学校には行きたいけど行けてないのですか？それとも、行きたくないのですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Is it that you want to go to school but can't, or that you don't want to go?

dialogue.content: いきたくないですね
dialogue.English: I don't want to go.

dialogue.content: そっか、そっか、行きたくないのですね。そんな気持ちになったのは何かきっかげがあったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see, I see. You don't want to go. Was there anything specific that made you start feeling that way?

dialogue.content: 入学してから友達もできずに孤立していたので
dialogue.English: Ever since I started school, I haven't been able to make any friends and I've felt isolated.

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ
dialogue.English: I see, yes.

dialogue.content: そうっだのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お友達が出来なくてさみしい気持ちでしたね
dialogue.English: You must have felt lonely not being able to make friends.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、そんなさみしい気持ちが続いて学校に行きなくなくなってしまったのですね。つらい時間でしたね。
dialogue.English: I see... That ongoing loneliness led to you not wanting to go to school anymore. It must have been a tough time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一つ聞きたいのですが、たつやさんは中学生ですよね、入学したときにどんな学校生活を送りたいな～ってイメージしていましたか？
dialogue.English: I'd like to ask one thing, Tatsuya. You're in middle school, right? When you first enrolled, what kind of school life did you imagine you would have?

dialogue.content: そうですねもっと友達がいて充実した生活がおくれたらって思ってました
dialogue.English: Well, I thought I would have more friends and lead a more fulfilling life.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね、充実してお友達がいる生活をイメージされていたのですね
dialogue.English: I see—you envisioned a fulfilling school life with friends.

dialogue.content: でも、実際はちょっと違っていたのですね
dialogue.English: But in reality, it was a little different, wasn't it?

dialogue.content: はい違いました
dialogue.English: Yes, it was different.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、、イメージと違ってると落ち込むし悲しい気持ちになりますよね。。お友達が出来なかったのは、なぜ出来なかったのかなってご自分で感じますか？
dialogue.English: I see... When reality doesn't match your expectations, it can make you feel down and sad. Do you have any sense of why you couldn't make friends?

dialogue.content: わかりません馴染めなかったです
dialogue.English: I'm not sure. I just couldn't fit in.

dialogue.content: ちょっと掘り下げて聞いちゃいますけど、辛かったら答えなくていいですので無理しないでくださいね
dialogue.English: I'm going to dig a little deeper, but if it's painful, you don't have to answer. Please don't force yourself.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、馴染めなかったのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you felt you couldn't fit in.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: たつやさんみたいになんか馴染めないなって思いながら過ごしている学生さんは多くいると聞きます。
dialogue.English: I've heard that there are many students like you, Tatsuya, who feel like they can't quite fit in.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか？
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: じぶんの気持ちを押し殺して、無理して友達作って苦しんでいる方もいると思うし、馴染めないからもういいやって割り切る人もいるし、人それぞれの気持ちが有って同然だと私は思います。
dialogue.English: I think some people suppress their own feelings and struggle to force friendships, while others decide it's okay not to fit in and just accept it. I believe it's natural for everyone to have their own individual feelings.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ですので、たつやさんみたいに学校に行きたくないって思ってしまうのは自然な事だと思います。いま、毎日おうちで過ごしているのですか？
dialogue.English: Therefore, I think it's natural for someone like you to feel like you don't want to go to school. Are you spending every day at home now?

dialogue.content: はい家で過ごしてます
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m spending my time at home.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、おうちで過ごしていて、どんなお気持ちですか？
dialogue.English: I see. How do you feel as you spend time at home?

dialogue.content: 毎日特に何も考えずにゆっくりできるのでもういいかなって思ってます
dialogue.English: I can relax every day without thinking about anything in particular, so I'm starting to think this is fine.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、もういいかなって思うのですね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you're starting to think it might be fine this way.

dialogue.content: ご両親は心配されていますか？
dialogue.English: Are your parents worried?

dialogue.content: そうですね気にかけてくれてはいます
dialogue.English: Well, they are concerned about me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、ご両親とはどんなお話をしていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. What kinds of conversations are you having with your parents?

dialogue.content: 最近はあまり学校の話はしなくて特に決まった会話はないです
dialogue.English: Lately, we don't talk much about school, and we don't have any specific conversations.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。ご両親も心配はしてるけどたつやさんの気持ちを尊重されているのでしょうかね。
dialogue.English: I see. Perhaps your parents are worried, but they are also respecting your feelings.

dialogue.content: 素敵なご両親ですね
dialogue.English: They sound like wonderful parents.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: たつやさんは、今学校にいけないとおっしゃっていましたが、これからどうしたいと思っていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Tatsuya, you mentioned you aren't able to go to school right now. What are you thinking about doing moving forward?

dialogue.content: そうですねやっぱり将来は不安もあるので通信の学校にいくかもしれません
dialogue.English: Well, I am worried about the future, so I might go to a correspondence school.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね、通信の学校などかんがえているのですね、とても素晴らしいですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're considering options like a correspondence school. That's really wonderful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 両親のすすめもあって考えてます
dialogue.English: I'm also considering it because my parents suggested it.

dialogue.content: 今の学校に馴染めないと感じられて、学校に行くのをやめ、進路をしっかりと考えておられて、素晴らしいと感じました。
dialogue.English: You felt you couldn't fit in at your current school, stopped going, and are now seriously considering your future path. I think that's admirable.

dialogue.content: ご両親ともきちんと将来の事について話されていらっしゃって心強いですね
dialogue.English: It's reassuring that you're properly discussing your future with your parents.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 色々考えてくれてるみたいです
dialogue.English: It seems they've been thinking about various options for me.

dialogue.content: ご両親の想いもそれにきちんと向き合っておられるたつやさんも素敵です
dialogue.English: It's wonderful that your parents are so thoughtful, and it's also wonderful that you are sincerely considering their feelings.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 家族が支えあえるのってなかなか難しい事だと思いますので、そのお気持ち、是非大切にされてくださいね
dialogue.English: I think it can be quite difficult for a family to support each other, so please cherish that connection.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: 少し気持ちが楽になりました
dialogue.English: I feel a bit more at ease now.

dialogue.content: 通信制の学校の事もご両親としらべて、前を向かれているようでとっても安心しました。
dialogue.English: I'm very relieved to hear that you're looking into correspondence schools with your parents and seem to be looking forward.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 人それぞれの人生の選択が有っていいと私も思います。たつやさんの人生に選択支を与えてくださるご両親もとても尊く感じました。
dialogue.English: I also believe that everyone should be able to choose their own path in life. I find it very admirable that your parents are giving you options for your life.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: たつやさんがより良い選択ができる事、それからこれからどんな大人になっていかれるのか、私も一緒に応援できたらと思います
dialogue.English: I hope you can make the best choices for yourself, and I'd like to cheer you on as you grow into the adult you'll become.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: 今日は話したいことが話せましたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Were you able to talk about what you wanted to today?

dialogue.content: はいそうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.content: これで失礼いたしますまたお願いします
dialogue.English: That's all for me. I hope we can talk again.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、そう感じていただけて良かったです。また、お気軽にいらしてくださいね
dialogue.English: I see, I'm glad to hear that. Please feel free to come back anytime.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Goodbye for now.
